environment.description: AWS Step Functions workflow triggered by API Gateway. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with standard schema. The 'orders' table has columns (id, tenant_id, product, quantity, status, total_amount). Database user 'app_service' has SELECT/UPDATE on all rows. No row-level security policies are enabled. The SET app.current_tenant is used only for pgaudit logging, not access control. Step Functions execution role has full invoke permissions on this Lambda.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 on RDS, no RLS policies enabled
config.db_user: app_service with GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON orders
config.step_functions: Standard workflow, no input validation on order_id
config.api_gateway: JWT authorizer extracts tenant_id into Step Functions input
config.network: Lambda in VPC with RDS access, no additional network segmentation per tenant
